messages:
maya: Heads-up — Terrafirma private rollout preflight. Need to lock a time for the deployment review call this week. Key owners: @sanjay (network), @eva (security), @liam (runtime).

sanjay: I can do Thurs afternoon (PST) or Fri morning. Prefer Thurs after 2pm for runbook walkthrough.

eva: Thu works for me but need the KMS & cert bit in the agenda. Also will ask legal for the data flow diagram.

liam: Fri morning ok for me, but if we do Thu I'd like 30m at end for canary plan and fallback.

maya: Quick poll — react with :one: for Thu 2:30–3:15 PT, :two: for Fri 9–9:45 PT. I'll pick based on reactions.

calendar-bot: maya added a tentative event — Terrafirma private deployment review — Thu 14:30 PT (tentative). Link: https://cal.redwood.com/event/abcd1234

ops-oncall: Can we add a note to check on cross-account VPC peering ENIs and route53 propagation? Last time that tripped us.

maya: Good call. Agenda draft below — please call out additions.

```
Agenda:
1) Rollout scope & timelines (5m)
2) Network/VPC peering & firewall rules (10m)
3) KMS/HSM & cert rotation plan (10m)
4) Runtime capacity + canary thresholds (10m)
5) Observability & rollback triggers (10m)
6) Action items & owners (5m)
```

sanjay: Add: verify customer CIDR and direct connect L2 hops. I'll paste peering CIDRs before call.

liam: I'll attach perf-run logs and the suggested autoscale window.

maya: Eva — can you bring the compliance checklist? If legal hasn't finished, just the open items.

eva: Yep. Also want to confirm E2E test coverage for secret injection path.

deploy-bot: deploy-checklist:update — runbook v2.3 uploaded to /runbooks/terrafirma/v2.3; checksum 9f8a7b.

maya: Cool. Looks like Thu wins so far. I'll finalize invite after one more ack. If anyone cannot make it, drop notes here and we'll do async signoff. :thumbsup:

liam: Ack.

eva: Ack.

sanjay: Ack — will paste CIDRs by EOD.

maya: Thanks all. If you have preflight docs, upload to the calendar event or paste links here so I can circulate a single packet before the call.
